chunks: So be fearful of God and listen to me.

key_terms.فَاتَّقُوا: Be fearful of / Be conscious of

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'So be fearful of God and listen to me' in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse underscores the inseparable link between taqwa (God-consciousness) and obedience to the Prophet, a concept central to Shia theology as the foundation for following the Imams. It serves as a divine mandate where spiritual piety is validated through adherence to the authoritative figure sent by God, reinforcing the principle of Wilayah.
